policy: Execution class describes the minimum required execution surface for the core workflow. It is not a safety guarantee or compatibility score.

classes.chat-native: Core job can be completed from the skill inside ChatGPT without a mandatory external app, local runtime, or skill-introduced network dependency.
classes.native-tools: Core job depends on one or more native ChatGPT tools but not on a mandatory external account integration.
classes.connected: Core job requires an external app, plugin, MCP server, API, OAuth connection, or other connected provider.
classes.local-agent: Core deterministic workflow materially depends on a local filesystem, CLI, executable script, or agent runtime.

openai-agents-sdk-builder.minimum_setup: Local agent/runtime with filesystem access; generated app later needs OpenAI API credentials to run.
openai-agents-sdk-builder.evidence: Packaged smoke tests exercise the deterministic scaffolder; this does not prove an equivalent complete workflow inside ChatGPT.

realtime-api-integration.minimum_setup: Local Node/runtime and filesystem access; generated integration later needs network access and OpenAI API credentials.
realtime-api-integration.evidence: Packaged smoke tests exercise deterministic starter generation; live Realtime execution remains a separate evidence gap.

chatgpt-apps-deployer.minimum_setup: Local filesystem/runtime for deterministic release-manifest generation.
chatgpt-apps-deployer.evidence: Manifest generation is directly tested; platform submission or approval is not performed by the skill.

codex-pr-reviewer.minimum_setup: Local filesystem/runtime to validate rules and generate the deterministic review prompt.
codex-pr-reviewer.evidence: Prompt generation is directly tested; fetching and reviewing a live pull request happens on another surface.

cs-navigator.minimum_setup: Install CS Navigator. The technical plugin slug remains cs-navigator. The core routing workflow is chat-native; connected actions are optional and retain normal platform permission and confirmation requirements.
cs-navigator.evidence: CS Navigator 0.15.0 exact private candidate b8a18c87526883dc01331c1f3428c77a375ebf5dd33a8b038db3c6641af29bb2 passed the recorded 12/12 native semantic Human Capability matrix on 2026-10-08. This qualifies the Navigator behavior covered by that matrix; bundled 0.15 workflows remain individually designed unless separately tested.
